notes.title: Update to version 1.3.3
notes.content: Entire game now compatible with Lovense devices.

notes.title: July 15th Update - Achievement Fix
notes.content:
We fixed an issue that was causing the achievements to not unlock properly. 

For old users you may have to delete the persistent data from two locations:
- AppData/Roaming/RenPy/sexcalibur
- Your Steam installation folder, Steam/steamapps/common/Sexcalibur: Knights of the Pound Table/games/saves
